explanation: Compute all-pairs shortest distances with Floyd–Warshall. For each candidate road, evaluate the savings between every ordered city pair through either direction of that road and retain the first proposal with greatest total savings.
timeComplexity: O(V^3 + P V^2) time for V cities and P proposals.
